cases.title: Leaf Studio
cases.use_case: Botanical identity reveal for a presentation or brand introduction
cases.use_case_zh: 用于品牌介绍与提案的植物标识描线
cases.method: Native SVG geometry; semantic stem, leaves, veins and identity accents.
cases.limitations: Original demonstration identity, not commissioned client work. No automatic tracing is involved.
cases.prompt: Animate this botanical identity: grow the main stem and leaves first, then the veins and small accents. Keep all original shapes and colors. Deliver an offline HTML, GIF and transparent PNG.
cases.revision_prompt: Slow the animation to 1x and show the veins after the leaf silhouettes.

cases.title: Coffee Story
cases.use_case: Product illustration for a launch note, menu presentation or README
cases.use_case_zh: 用于产品介绍、菜单提案与文档展示的咖啡插画
cases.method: Native SVG paths; cup and saucer, then drink and steam, then beans and emblem.
cases.limitations: Original editorial illustration with deliberate flat colors. This is not a photo-to-vector claim.
cases.prompt: Draw this coffee illustration in a natural order: saucer and cup, then the drink and steam, then the beans and cup emblem. Keep the background transparent in HTML and PNG; use a warm cream matte for the GIF.
cases.revision_prompt: Make the steam appear later and export a 2x GIF for a compact announcement.

cases.title: White Letter Badge
cases.use_case: Raster logo reveal that preserves white lettering and transparent margins
cases.use_case_zh: 保留白色文字和透明边缘的位图标识动画
cases.method: Transparent PNG rendered from the authored SVG; supplied source SVG contours plus original PNG pixel reveal. No background removal or automatic tracing.
cases.limitations: The source SVG is deliberately available for this controlled raster fixture. This does not demonstrate recovering exact contours from an arbitrary logo.
cases.prompt: Animate this transparent badge PNG and use the supplied aligned contours. Keep the white TB lettering opaque, draw it after the frame, and preserve the original PNG pixels at the end.
cases.revision_prompt: Keep all white letter pixels and export a transparent final PNG plus a cream-background GIF.

cases.title: Courtyard House
cases.use_case: Architectural identity reveal for a property presentation or a studio portfolio
cases.use_case_zh: 用于房产提案、住宅介绍与建筑作品集的立面展示
cases.method: Native SVG facade geometry: building volumes and roof, then openings and landscaping, then material details.
cases.limitations: A fictional original house illustration; not a construction drawing, measured plan or real property listing.
cases.prompt: Introduce this courtyard home by drawing its building volumes and roof, then windows and the entrance, then garden and facade details. Preserve the original palette and landscape proportions. Deliver offline HTML, GIF and transparent PNG.
cases.revision_prompt: Let the entrance arch appear earlier and slow the roof drawing. Keep the existing house geometry.

cases.title: City Route
cases.use_case: Day-trip itinerary reveal for a travel proposal or a visitor guide
cases.use_case_zh: 用于旅行提案、城市漫游与游客指南的路线演示
cases.method: Native SVG folded-map illustration: map and river, streets and landmarks, itinerary route, then numbered stops and compass.
cases.limitations: A fictional illustrative map with invented landmarks; not geographic or turn-by-turn navigation data.
cases.prompt: Build this itinerary map from the land and river to the landmarks, then reveal the red walking route and its four stops. Keep the numbered markers and compass legible. Export an offline HTML and a cream-background GIF.
cases.revision_prompt: Draw the red walking route later and spend more time on the four numbered stops.

cases.title: Orbit Lesson
cases.use_case: Illustrative orbit diagram for a classroom slide or an educational explainer
cases.use_case_zh: 用于课堂讲解与科普说明的轨道示意图
cases.method: Native SVG schematic: orbital paths and central star, then stylized planets, arrows and hand-authored path labels.
cases.limitations: Illustrative only and visibly labeled NOT TO SCALE. Planet sizes, distances and positions are invented; this is not a physical simulation or astronomical ephemeris.
cases.prompt: Draw the orbital guides and central star first, then the stylized planets, direction arrows and explanatory labels. Keep the NOT TO SCALE caption. Deliver offline HTML, GIF and transparent PNG for a lesson slide.
cases.revision_prompt: Keep the orbit lines subtle, reveal the planets one by one, and delay the scale disclaimer until the end.

cases.title: Celebration Card
cases.use_case: Portrait event invitation for a celebration announcement or a newsletter
cases.use_case_zh: 用于活动预告、庆典邀请与邮件通讯的竖版邀请卡
cases.method: Native SVG invitation: arched card and ribbon, balloons and decorative strokes, then original JOIN US lettering and date paths.
cases.limitations: A fictional invitation with a demonstration date. All lettering is original monoline path geometry, not an external typeface.
cases.prompt: Reveal this portrait invitation: draw the arched card, then balloons and ribbon, then the JOIN US lettering and date. Preserve the portrait aspect ratio and the warm rose-and-gold palette. Deliver HTML, GIF and PNG.
cases.revision_prompt: Show JOIN US after both balloons and use 0.75x playback for a slower invitation reveal.

cases.title: Night Market
cases.use_case: Rich editorial streetscape for a travel story, event introduction or placemaking presentation
cases.use_case_zh: 用于旅行故事、夜市活动与城市空间提案的多层街景
cases.method: Native SVG layered scene: skyline and shop structures, windows and awnings, then lanterns, market stalls, visitors and bicycle details.
cases.limitations: An original fictional city block, not a real destination, business listing or photo tracing.
cases.prompt: Draw this night market from its skyline and three storefronts to windows, awnings and stalls. Leave lantern ribs, visitors and small street details late, then reveal the original night palette. Export offline HTML, GIF and PNG.
cases.revision_prompt: Give the lanterns more drawing time, reveal the stalls before the visitors, and export at 1.5x.

cases.title: Camera Exploded
cases.use_case: Exploded product anatomy for an editorial launch story or educational presentation
cases.use_case_zh: 用于产品叙事、科普展示与技术讲解的光学结构拆解
cases.method: Native SVG separated optical groups, aperture, sensor board and camera shell; then mechanical details and callout leaders.
cases.limitations: A fictional illustrative camera anatomy, not an engineered assembly, repair guide or representation of a real product.
cases.prompt: Introduce this fictional camera through an exploded illustration. Draw lens groups and the body first, then sensor and aperture, then fasteners, surface details and annotation leaders. Keep the original geometry and final colors.
cases.revision_prompt: Let the lens elements draw one by one before the body and slow the sensor reveal.

cases.title: Greenhouse Study
cases.use_case: Dense botanical environment for a garden concept, educational story or architecture portfolio
cases.use_case_zh: 用于花园方案、自然教育与建筑作品集的密集植物温室
cases.method: Native SVG structural glazing, shelves, individually editable plant silhouettes, foreground specimens and irrigation details.
cases.limitations: A fictional greenhouse illustration, not a construction plan, botanical identification guide or engineering simulation.
cases.prompt: Draw the greenhouse envelope and glass ribs first, then its tiered benches and plants. Keep each specimen editable. Finish with pots, irrigation and garden tools before revealing the original greens.
cases.revision_prompt: Draw the foreground plants later, slow the glass ribs, and create a 720-pixel GIF on a cream background.
